author: grace
text: Hi! New here (backend, Atlas). How do I get access to the staging Postgres? The onboarding doc links a page that 404s.

author: devon
text: Welcome Grace! That page moved. Request the `atlas-staging-ro` group in Okta, Kwame approves. Then `corvid db connect staging` with the CLI. Read-only by default.

author: jasmine
text: Is there a way to see Atlas on staging without bugging an engineer? I want screenshots for the launch email.

author: devon
text: Yep, ask Kwame to add your workspace to the staging allowlist. Prod is off for everyone.
